code='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    rows = {r for r in range(h) if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r])}\n    cols = {c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h))}\n    return [[2 if r in rows or c in cols else v for c, v in enumerate(row)] for r, row in enumerate(grid)]\n'''
